reviews.text:
Seriously irritating app if you try using it while listening to music/ podcasts/ audiobooks.. The tracking functionality is great.

But it gets only 3 stars since I am thiiiis close to choosing a different tracker because MMT makes it impossible to track a trip without fooling with one's phone CONstantly, if you want to listen to an audiobook or podcast or music at the same time. Here’s why: I use MMT while walking my dog, and I like to play something to listen to at the same time. If the dog stops for a sniff or a pee, or if we happen to be going too slowly for the gps to track our progress, MMT beeps in notification and temporarily stops tracking. Fine, fair enough. The problem is that every single time this happens, the notifying beep ALSO shuts off whatever music or audiobook I have going, and this doesn't start up again when tracking does, I have to manually restart it. Every.single.time. I have to dig out my phone, unlock it, open the audiobook or music app, restart the book or music, put the phone away again. This is every few minutes when you're walking a dog who likes to sniff. It's seriously ridiculous, I'm sure there are plenty of MMT users who listen to music or podcasts while on their run or walk or bike trip and would really love to just hit 'start' and 'play' and go. PLEASE make a setting to turn MMT tracking-has-stopped notifications OFF so they they don't interrupt the audio on the phone and result in a truly maddening user experience!

•I use it to record my walks & occasional run and have enjoyed watching my pace improve. 
•The summary for each activity is really comprehensive and scrolling through your history gives a great sense of accomplishment.

•I have not yet felt the need to buy any in-app extras. What you get with the basic level suits me well at present.

reviews.text:
Needs to be Improved but has a great potential. I have used this App for 5 months now. The more I used it, the more I saw that the app has trouble tracking correctly for the first 15min of my walk. If my screen goes off, the app goes to sleep & the next time the screen is switched on, the app has to be restarted & a straight line is drawn between the two points of where the screen was on, instead of the actual route taken. This then registers a reduces distance & average mph. The only way to avoid this, is to keep turning the phone on every few minutes which is tiresome or leave the screen on but this drains the battery.

Leaderboard is a great idea but in its current format it is open to wide abuse just scroll down & check the records for the top 5 walkers of this week. People claiming to be walking between 20 & 100 miles in one outing with average walking speeds of between 6.7mph & 21mph. This is not physically possible for a human being. Parameters need to be set which would stop incorrect information being displayed. 

Sort these two issues out & you will have the best app on the market. It would be well worth paying for then but not as it is currently...
